description: Publication resources for the frozen 483-study bibliometric analysis of large language models in healthcare simulation education: six Online Resources, 18 exact searches, 9,719 retrieval occurrences, 3,919 candidate records, 547 eligible publication records and 64 alternate versions. Includes the corrected model-name audit, seven article figures and recovered agent Pilot. Later lead-author checks remain separate from frozen analysis. Original derived material CC BY 4.0; code MIT; restricted source text excluded.
title: Large Language Models in Healthcare Simulation Education: bibliometric analysis reproducibility package
